name: TrueWood Dark Smoke Oak Slats, Black Felt
summary: Solid rubberwood core wrapped in real oak veneer on three sides, in a Dark Smoke Oak finish, with a black acoustic felt backing.

texture.note: No manufacturer spec sheet is published; the recorded panel is 11.8 x 94.49 x 0.75 in, and the photos suggest 7 slats per panel, estimated 1.10 in faces and 0.586 in rectangular felt gaps on a 1.686 in pitch with lightly softened edges. The tile spans 7 pitches by 23.6 in; muted dark smoke oak tones are sampled from main.jpg, with black felt, and the normal profile estimates 0.50 in wood relief above 0.25 in backing.
